description:
Upgrade, reconfigure and extend the centre, driven by the need for improvements to access for disabled people, consisting of:
1.	Construction of two small extensions to the rear / north-east / Grove Road elevation.
2.	Creation of two new entrance doors within the front / south-west / Cambrian Road elevation. Two sets of French doors to be replaced with windows. 
3.	A new, compliant wheelchair ramp from Cambrian Road to the new front / south-west facing entrances.
4.	Provision of double door access on the rear / north-east / Grove Road elevation.  
5.	Insertion of new fenestration in the side / south-east elevation.
6.	Installation of compliant signage. 
7.	Remodelling existing external stores. 
8.	Removal of front railings bounding Cambrian Road to provide access to proposed new cycle storage.
9.	Internal reconfiguration, including new accessible WCs, wider door openings and new manager’s office.
